# Calculate the header of the column with the maximum value for each row
# We only need to calculate for rows 2, 3, 4 (0-indexed) to fill H3, H4, H5
results = {}
for idx in [2, 3, 4]:
    # Select the data columns (D to G) for the current row
    row_values = df.iloc[idx, 3:7]
    # Find the index of the maximum value
    # idxmax returns the index of the first occurrence of the maximum
    max_col_idx = row_values.idxmax()
    # Map the index back to the header name from row 0
    header_name = df.iloc[0, max_col_idx]
    results[idx] = header_name

# Use openpyxl to write the literal values to the specific cells
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
ws = wb.active

# H3 is row 3, col 8. H4 is row 4, col 8. H5 is row 5, col 8.
ws.cell(row=3, column=8).value = results[2]
ws.cell(row=4, column=8).value = results[3]
ws.cell(row=5, column=8).value = results[4]

# Ensure output directory exists and save
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)",
